reuse.why: Extracts unlinkAccount's local field-clearing update into clearAccountBankLink and uses it from both unlinkAccount and the shared linkBankSyncAccount path, reusing the existing already-linked lookup.

duplication.why: The unlink update exists once and is shared; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The flag is on LinkAccountBaseParams and the takeover is in linkBankSyncAccount, the single link path for all providers, after the existing closed-account guard.

scope.why: Only the flag, the takeover, the extraction and tests.

maintainability.why: Minimal, readable change that keeps the provider-side cleanup of unlinkAccount out of the takeover as required and leaves the other guards untouched.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through linkBankSyncAccount and the extracted clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The update was moved into a shared helper, not duplicated.
